test_cases.title: Successful login redirects to Dashboard
preconditions: User account exists with email test.user@example.com and password ValidPass123!
test_cases.expected_result: HTTP 200 response from authentication endpoint, URL changes to /dashboard, and all primary dashboard widgets are visible.
test_cases.automation_reason: Straightforward UI flow; can be automated with Selenium/WebDriver or mobile UI frameworks.

test_cases.title: Password input is masked and not exposed in DOM/network
test_steps: Focus on Password field and type 'Secret123'.
Capture network request payload for login submission.
test_cases.expected_result: Input element has type='password' and characters appear as dots/asterisks; request payload does not contain plaintext password (e.g., password is hashed or sent over TLS only).
test_cases.automation_reason: Can be validated via DOM inspection and network proxy (e.g., BrowserMob) in automated script.

test_cases.title: Invalid credentials display error message without redirect
preconditions: User account exists with email test.user@example.com and password ValidPass123!
test_cases.expected_result: Error toast/inline message 'Invalid email or password' appears, URL remains on login page, no dashboard elements loaded.
test_cases.automation_reason: Error message detection is easily scripted.

test_cases.title: Email format validation prevents submission
test_steps: Check if form submission is blocked.
test_cases.expected_result: Login button remains disabled or submission is prevented; browser shows native HTML5 validation error.
test_cases.automation_reason: Can verify button state or validation message via UI automation.

test_cases.title: Empty password field triggers client‑side validation
test_cases.expected_result: Login attempt is blocked; UI shows 'Password is required' message; no network request is sent.
test_cases.automation_reason: Validation message can be asserted in automated UI test.

test_cases.title: Account lockout after exceeding failed login attempts
preconditions: User account exists with email lockout.user@example.com.
test_steps: After attempts, attempt login again with correct password 'CorrectPass1!'.
test_cases.expected_result: After threshold (e.g., 5 attempts), server returns lockout status (e.g., 423 Locked) with message 'Account temporarily locked'. Subsequent attempts, even with correct credentials, are blocked until lockout period expires.
test_cases.automation_reason: Looped login attempts can be scripted; response codes and messages can be validated.

test_cases.title: Rate limiting headers present on failed login response
test_steps: Send rapid succession (e.g., 20) HTTP POST login requests with invalid credentials to authentication endpoint.
test_cases.expected_result: Responses include headers such as 'X-Rate-Limit-Limit', 'X-Rate-Limit-Remaining', and appropriate 429 Too Many Requests after limit is reached.
test_cases.automation_reason: Can be performed with API testing tools (Postman, JMeter) in CI.

test_cases.title: Authentication response time under normal load meets performance SLA
preconditions: Test environment with baseline load (e.g., 100 concurrent users).
test_steps: Simulate 100 concurrent login requests with valid credentials using load testing tool.
Measure average response time of authentication endpoint.
test_cases.expected_result: Average response time ≤ 2 seconds and 95th percentile ≤ 3 seconds.
test_cases.automation_reason: Load testing scripts can be integrated into performance pipeline.

test_cases.title: Login page complies with WCAG 2.1 AA contrast and focus order
test_steps: Load login page with a screen reader (e.g., NVDA).
Navigate using keyboard Tab key through Email, Password, and Login button.
Verify that each element has discernible label and sufficient color contrast.
Confirm error messages are announced to assistive technology.
test_cases.expected_result: All interactive elements are reachable via keyboard, have appropriate ARIA labels, and meet contrast ratios; error messages are read aloud.
test_cases.automation_reason: Requires manual accessibility validation tools and human observation.
